checks.finding: Exact four kinds, budgets, CPU/device scope, argv, manifest/entry/contract pins, root launch admission and prerequisite type/value gates.
Fresh run directory, cooperative card lock, first idle/memory checks, fixed15second wait and second fresh idle/memory checks; no auto-wait/retry.
Fixed CPU affinity and numeric thread limits; all kinds backend autoload0; CPU audit no device inspector/CANN wrapper, NPU entry must explicitly register torch_npu.
Owned-process supervision delegated to separately SHA-pinned existing supervisor; exact typed terminal report predicates and final unchanged plan/pins; no training/result acceptance invented.

boundaries: Static source/test review only; no SSH, model, NPU, real job dispatch or repeated tests.
Cooperative lock cannot prevent an unrelated noncooperating process taking the card; fresh checks only attest their instants.
Actual supervisor implementation and launch plan/source pins remain root admission responsibilities.
Worker complete is execution completion, not independent numerical/quality acceptance.
